source: Existing certified F1 historical-development outcome bundle; exact prior Poisson input hash. No lineup, starter, odds, target-game features or external outcomes.
representation: Ten predictors, five for each exact team: scoring-zero rate, allowing-zero rate, joint NRFI rate, log1p mean runs scored, log1p mean runs allowed. Last30 strictly earlier same-season games; each rate/mean shrinks with10 pseudo-games toward strictly prior league rate/mean. Minimum300 league games and20 team games. Predict every game on date before any same-date histories update.
learner: Direct joint NRFI Bernoulli gradient boosting of decision stumps, not factorized zero-run probabilities or analog matching. Refit at first available date each month using all prior eligible contexts of same season, minimum600. Initialize smoothed prior training NRFI logit. Fixed60 rounds, learning_rate0.05, Newton leaf update with L2 denominator10, minimum60 training rows each child. Ten features; candidate cuts at20/40/60/80th empirical training percentiles. Greedy maximum positive Newton gain versus unsplit parent; deterministic feature/cut ties. No validation early stopping, grids, calibration refit or external selection.
selection: NRFI only when p_NRFI>=0.75; no YRFI flip or alternate thresholds. No pushes for exact completed F1 outcomes.
baseline: Prior league modal NRFI/YRFI on identical selected cohort and eligible population; also report unconditional NRFI prevalence.
limitations: Repeated historical development only. Inherits prior-game outcome certificate; no claim of as-published lineup/pitcher or prospective availability proof. No retuning after this one-shot historical evaluation.
